name: io.github.cam10001110101/outlook-email
title: Outlook Email Processor
description: Cross-platform MCP server for Microsoft Outlook email processing with semantic search, vector embeddings via Ollama, and MongoDB storage. Supports Windows COM, macOS AppleScript, and Microsoft Graph API.

packageArguments.description: Module path to run the MCP server

environmentVariables.name: MONGODB_URI
environmentVariables.description: MongoDB connection string for storing vector embeddings (e.g., mongodb://localhost:27017/MCP?authSource=admin)

environmentVariables.name: SQLITE_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to SQLite database file for email metadata storage

environmentVariables.name: COLLECTION_NAME
environmentVariables.description: MongoDB collection name for storing email embeddings

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama server URL for generating embeddings

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama embedding model name to use

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Email provider: 'auto' (detect platform), 'windows' (COM), 'mac' (AppleScript), or 'graph' (Microsoft Graph API)

environmentVariables.name: PROCESS_DELETED_ITEMS
environmentVariables.description: Whether to process Deleted Items folder ('true' or 'false')

environmentVariables.name: GRAPH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD application (client) ID - required when OUTLOOK_PROVIDER=graph

environmentVariables.name: GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD client secret - required when OUTLOOK_PROVIDER=graph

environmentVariables.name: GRAPH_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD tenant ID - required when OUTLOOK_PROVIDER=graph

environmentVariables.name: GRAPH_USER_EMAILS
environmentVariables.description: Mailboxes to access: comma-separated emails or 'All' for auto-discovery - required when OUTLOOK_PROVIDER=graph

tools.name: process_emails
tools.description: Process emails from Outlook with date range filtering, store in SQLite, and generate vector embeddings

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Semantic search across email content using MongoDB vector store

tools.name: export_email_data
tools.description: Export email data in CSV, JSON, HTML, or Excel format

tools.name: organize_emails_by_rules
tools.description: Organize emails based on custom rules

tools.name: check_data_consistency
tools.description: Verify consistency between SQLite and MongoDB data stores

requirements.ollama: Required for generating vector embeddings (nomic-embed-text model)
requirements.outlook: Windows: Outlook desktop app | macOS: Outlook for Mac | Graph: Azure AD app registration
